comment.narrative: Baseline value is expressed in weeks and is found in the projects logframe. The project aims to expand and improve access to better employment opportunities and inclusive social protection systems in partner countries. The project is a followup of the project SOCIEUX EU Expert Facility on Social Protection D23637 and this indicator refers to a specific project output. The assumption is that the reference year is the year the project SOCIEUX has ended and the current project has started. Sexdisaggregation is not applicable for this indicator.

Final target value is set in the Logframe found in the Description of the Action Annex I but also identical in the First Progress Report i.e. D38449SOCIEUXFirstPR201711.pdf. A decreasing trend is a positive factor for this indicator. Sexdisaggregation is not applicable for this indicator.

This is the latest data value available since 2018. The results have been independently verified during a ROM Review Mission. Sexdisaggregation is not available. There is no obvious risk of doublecounting. No apparent possible bias is detected. The project is multicountry with a global action and worldwide interventions of management and technical assistance activated on the basis of a demanddriven mechanism. An expansion to new beneficiary countries is already observed in year 2017.
